name: sample/fanout — parallel branches, merge, retry, sign-off gate
description: The full vocabulary in one graph: a 'parallel' node runs two INLINE branch graphs concurrently (fresh blackboard per branch; only 'research' gathers — side-effect 'act' nodes are rejected inside branches so conversation commits stay serial); 'merge' commits the branch outputs to the conversation in DECLARED edge order; 'act' composes the answer with on_failure='retry(2)'; 'critic' judges; 'gate' projects the verdict onto a boolean 'pass' with no LLM call. max_parallel caps the concurrent branches; every budget layer (graph, branch, node) is shown.
